svg.text: Z I 4, "On the Despisers of the Body" (1883)
"body am I through and through, and nothing besides"
BGE 12: the soul-atom expelled
"nothing besides": BGE 36 says it of the world
"soul is just a word for something on the body"
BGE 12: the hypothesis kept, "mortal soul"
"a great reason, a multiplicity with one sense"
BGE 12: subject-multiplicity, a society
"your small reason, 'spirit', a tool of your body"
GS 354: conscious thinking the smallest part
"it does not say I, but does I"
BGE 17: "it thinks"; the I an interpretation
"the self says to the ego: feel pain here!"
BGE 19: command; "obeys, or that he
believes to obey"
"one herd and one shepherd"; "a mighty commander,
an unknown sage: he is called self"; "it rules"
the residue: one against many
BGE 19: "the ruling class", "under-wills",
"a commonwealth": a class, its rank undetermined
the speech names one commander with a mind of its own; the argued text names a class and does not say
whether its rank is strength or authority; the map does not smooth the one into the other
